note: Configs describe strategy logic. IKQF backend must implement/loading these fields for live execution.

strategies.name: IKQF Relative Strength Rotation
strategies.purpose: Ranks liquid tokens and holds only the strongest candidate. Exits to USDT or rotates when the edge disappears.

strategies.name: IKQF Top Loser Reversal
strategies.purpose: Mean-reversion strategy: watches top liquid coins, finds the hardest dump, but only buys after stabilization/reversal confirmation.

strategies.name: IKQF TDI Bottom-to-Top Reversal
strategies.purpose: Your original TDI idea, hardened: buy lower TDI reversal only when market and structure confirm, then exit near upper TDI zone or earlier if edge fades.

strategies.name: IKQF Trend Pullback
strategies.purpose: Spot-only trend strategy: only buys pullbacks in confirmed uptrends and returns to USDT when trend health breaks.

strategies.name: IKQF Momentum Breakout
strategies.purpose: Buys strength, not weakness: enters only when resistance breaks with volume and liquidity, then protects gains with a trailing stop.

strategies.name: IKQF Regime Switcher
strategies.purpose: Meta-strategy that chooses which strategy to run based on market regime: trend, range, mean reversion, breakout, grid, or USDT flat.
